The claim states that the method differs from previous hardware shadow work [2] by using an off-screen render buffer instead of a volumetric shadow map, and by modifying the slice axis to allow shared slicing. Source [S4] explicitly states: 'Our approach differs from previous hardware shadow work [2] in two ways. First, rather than creating a volumetric shadow map, we utilize an off screen render buffer... This directly supports every part of the claim.
